name: com.adrianhomelab/leadgen-onrc
title: Leadgen ONRC Romania
description: Romanian company data for agents: 4.2M ONRC firms, ANAF status, financials 2008–2025. Free key.

tools.name: lookup_business
tools.description: Look up a Romanian company by name, CUI or hostname in the ONRC registry of 4.2M companies: a hostname ('emag.ro') resolves the firm that owns the domain, or says it could not identify it. Names are diacritic-insensitive ('paval' finds 'PAVAL'); a CUI matches exactly. Live companies rank first (exact name, then words), closed ones after; county lifts. For 'companies that do X in Y', search by activity and county.

query.description: Company name, CUI (tax ID) or website hostname to search for. Names are diacritic-insensitive ('paval' finds PAVĂL); a CUI ('2816464', 'RO2816464') matches exactly; a hostname ('emag.ro') resolves the firm that owns it.
query.title: Query

max_results.description: Maximum number of companies to return (1-100, default 10).
max_results.title: Max Results

county.description: Optional county hint (diacritic-insensitive): companies registered there rank higher. Not a filter.
county.title: County

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level and what it did not check, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount, record url).
compact.title: Compact

tools.name: lookup_companies
tools.description: Look up many Romanian companies by CUI in one call (up to 100): one result per input, in input order, each with found true/false and the company record. Each row is one lookup; rows past today's allowance come back not_processed (partial: true, remaining: rows to resend after the reset). fields or compact trims each record.

cuis.description: Up to 100 CUIs, as a list or one comma-separated string ('RO', spaces and leading zeros accepted, as in lookup_business).
cuis.title: Cuis

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level and what it did not check, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount, record url).
compact.title: Compact

tools.name: find_company_by_domain
tools.description: Find the Romanian company behind a website domain (dedeman.ro). Uses the registry's website field, else reads the site's home and legal/contact pages for the CUI or registration number it shows (matchedOn: registry_website, site_cui). Without one, it says so and offers name candidates from the page title or the domain name, each with a confidence (at most 0.7, never a match). One lookup.

domain.description: The website's domain ('dedeman.ro'); a URL or a www. host is reduced to it. Public domains only.
domain.title: Domain

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level and what it did not check, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount, record url).
compact.title: Compact

tools.name: match_companies
tools.description: Match a list of up to 500 records (name, optional county, domain or CUI) to Romanian companies: each row gets match {cui, companyName, confidence, matchedOn} and the record, or no_match with up to 3 candidates. A valid CUI wins (confidence 1.0). Each row is one lookup; rows past today's allowance come back not_processed (partial: true, remaining: rows to resend after the reset).

rows.description: Up to 500 records, each {name, county, domain, cui, ref} (any of them; ref is your own id, echoed back), or a bare string (a CUI, a domain or a name).
rows.title: Rows

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level and what it did not check, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount, record url).
compact.title: Compact

MatchRow.description: One record to match: any of name, county, domain, cui; ref (your own id) is echoed back.

county.description: Optional county hint (diacritic-insensitive): companies there rank higher.
county.title: County

domain.description: Optional website domain ('dedeman.ro'), matched to the registry's website field.
domain.title: Domain

cui.description: Optional CUI (tax code); a valid one wins (confidence 1.0).
cui.title: Cui

ref.description: Your own id for the row, echoed back unchanged.
ref.title: Ref

MatchRow.title: MatchRow

tools.name: lookup_by_category
tools.description: Find companies by what they do, not by name: a curated topic ('software', 'retail'), plain words ('dentists', a CAEN class title; see matched) or CAEN codes ('4321,4322'; 6201 also finds Rev.3 6210). Narrow by one county or several; filter by revenue, headcount, VAT, main activity, registration date (registered_since/registered_until). active_only (default) drops dead and ANAF-inactive companies.

topic.description: What the companies do: a curated topic ('software', 'retail'), plain words for a trade ('dentists', 'stomatologie'), a CAEN class title in Romanian or English, or CAEN codes ('6201' or '4321,4322'). Case-, space- and diacritic-insensitive. A number that names another activity in each revision takes a suffix: '4781r3' (Rev.3) or '4781r2' (Rev.2).
topic.title: Topic

county.description: Optional county to narrow to (diacritic-insensitive: 'bucuresti', 'cluj'; a county town such as 'Cluj-Napoca' or a Bucharest sector is read as its county); omit for nationwide. Several counties: a list (['Cluj', 'Iasi']) or one comma-separated string ('Cluj,Iasi'), the companies of any of them. An unknown county is an error (unknown_county) with suggestions, not 0 companies.
county.title: County

max_results.description: Maximum number of companies to return (1-100, default 10).
max_results.title: Max Results

legal_form.description: Optional legal form(s) to keep, comma-separated, case-insensitive: 'SRL', 'SA', 'PFA', 'II', or 'SRL,SA' (companies, no sole traders). Default: any form.
legal_form.title: Legal Form

active_only.description: Default true: drop companies that are not a lead (struck off, dissolving, in liquidation, insolvent or bankrupt, activity suspended, or ANAF fiscally inactive). false returns every company.
active_only.title: Active Only

has_website.description: true keeps only companies with a website on file in the registry (default false).
has_website.title: Has Website

min_revenue.description: Optional minimum net turnover in RON on the latest filing (FY2025, else FY2024). Companies without a filing never match a band.
min_revenue.title: Min Revenue

max_revenue.description: Optional maximum net turnover in RON on the latest filing.
max_revenue.title: Max Revenue

min_employees.description: Optional minimum average headcount on the latest filing.
min_employees.title: Min Employees

max_employees.description: Optional maximum average headcount on the latest filing.
max_employees.title: Max Employees

vat_payer.description: Optional: true keeps VAT-registered companies only, false only non-VAT payers (ANAF data). Omit for both.
vat_payer.title: Vat Payer

main_activity_only.description: Default false: a company matches when the code is ANY of its authorised activities (ONRC lists a dozen per company, most never practised). true keeps only companies whose DECLARED main activity is one of the codes (ANAF main CAEN, else the CAEN on the latest filing): fewer, more relevant companies. The Leadgen app's lists use true by default.
main_activity_only.title: Main Activity Only

sort.description: Order of the results: 'newest' registrations first (default), 'revenue' (latest filing's turnover, biggest first) or 'employees' (headcount, biggest first); companies without a filing come last.
sort.title: Sort

registered_since.description: Optional ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD': keep only companies registered on or after that day, inclusive, on the registry date (firme.data_inmatriculare).
registered_since.title: Registered Since

registered_until.description: Optional ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD': keep only companies registered on or before that day, inclusive. With registered_since, a window.
registered_until.title: Registered Until

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level and what it did not check, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount, record url).
compact.title: Compact

tools.name: lookup_director
tools.description: Find Romanian companies by the name of a director or legal representative (ONRC). Diacritic-insensitive. Whole words: 'pop maria' finds POP MARIA, not POPA MARIANA; prefix=true matches prefixes. The registry has no personal ID, so one name can be several people: homonyms and byCounty say so. Use this when you know a person rather than a company.

name.description: Director / representative name to search for (e.g. 'Ion Popescu'); diacritic-insensitive, each word a whole word of the name.
name.title: Name

max_results.description: Maximum number of companies to return (1-100, default 10).
max_results.title: Max Results

prefix.description: true matches each word as a prefix ('pop' also finds POPA, POPESCU); default false (whole words).
prefix.title: Prefix

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level and what it did not check, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount, record url).
compact.title: Compact

tools.name: extract_contacts
tools.description: Crawl a company website and extract emails, phone numbers and social profiles. Accepts a bare domain or a full URL; max_pages (1-20, default 5) bounds the crawl.

website.description: The website to crawl: a bare domain ('example.com') or a full URL ('https://example.com').
website.title: Website

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (1-20, default 5).
max_pages.title: Max Pages

tools.name: enrich_company
tools.description: A whole-firm profile in one call: the ONRC registry record plus the contacts discovered on that company's website, each labelled with a confidence and a source. Prefer this over a registry lookup then a contact extraction when you want everything about one company. cui is its tax code; website overrides the registered one; max_pages bounds the crawl; refresh=true crawls now instead of answering from the cache.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI), e.g. '2816464'; 'RO' and leading zeros are accepted.
cui.title: Cui

website.description: Optional website override (domain or URL). When omitted, the company's registered website is used (an error if none is on file).
website.title: Website

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (1-20, default 5).
max_pages.title: Max Pages

refresh.description: true crawls now even if a cached result exists (default false: answer from the cache when there is one).
refresh.title: Refresh

tools.name: lookup_domain
tools.description: WHOIS plus DNS records (A, MX, NS, TXT) and an SPF/DMARC email-security audit for a domain. Use it to profile a company's web estate or check its email posture. include_dns and include_security toggle the two halves.

domain.description: Domain name to look up (e.g. 'example.com'); a URL is reduced to its host.
domain.title: Domain

include_dns.description: Include DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, SOA); default true.
include_dns.title: Include Dns

include_security.description: Include the SPF/DMARC email-security check; default true.
include_security.title: Include Security

tools.name: lookup_financials
tools.description: Annual financial statements for a Romanian company from Ministry of Finance filings, every fiscal year on record since 2008: revenue, profit, headcount and balance-sheet lines in RON with each year's ratios (growth, margins, equity ratio, liquidity), plus a summary (3/5/10-year CAGR, loss years, health score). If you only have a name, look the company up first to get its CUI.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI), e.g. '2816464'; 'RO' and leading zeros are accepted.
cui.title: Cui

tools.name: lookup_financial_ratios
tools.description: Financial analysis of a Romanian company: multi-year revenue trend (YoY, 3/5/10-year CAGR), margins, headcount, solvency and liquidity ratios, a 0–100 health score with its rule-by-rule breakdown, red flags, and peer percentiles within the same CAEN activity and county. Verdict: 'growing', 'stable' or 'distressed'. The raw yearly figures are in the annual financial statements.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI), e.g. '2816464'; 'RO' and leading zeros are accepted.
cui.title: Cui

tools.name: watch_company
tools.description: Register a company (by CUI) to monitor. Stores a fingerprint of its current registry record as the baseline; each watchlist poll then reports changes between monthly ONRC snapshots - a new director, a new CAEN activity, an address or status change - and when ANAF declares it fiscally inactive or its VAT status flips.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI) of the company to watch, e.g. '2816464'. Watching a company you already watch changes nothing.
cui.title: Cui

tools.name: watch_caen
tools.description: Watch a CAEN activity code, optionally scoped to one county, for newly registered companies. A registration-date cutoff is the baseline: only companies registered after it are reported, and each watchlist poll slides the cutoff forward so each new company surfaces once. A retired CAEN Rev.2 code (6201) also watches its Rev.3 successor (6210), with a warning.

code.description: CAEN activity code to watch (e.g. '6210'); a retired Rev.2 code also watches its Rev.3 successor.
code.title: Code

county.description: Optional county name to scope the watch to (diacritic-insensitive); omit to watch nationwide.
county.title: County

tools.name: poll_watchlist
tools.description: Collect everything the watch tools have found: call it to drain the changeset for every watch owned by your API key, most severe first. Company watches return an 'updated' entry with the changed fields and risk; CAEN and county watches return the 'new' companies registered since the last poll (200 a poll, the rest next).

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List every company and CAEN activity your API key watches, each with what changed since the last watchlist poll, most severe first. A peek: nothing is marked as seen (only a poll does that). Free and never counted as a lookup, also with 0 left today.

tools.name: unwatch
tools.description: Stop tracking a company (CUI) or a CAEN code (including its county); the tracking and its reference status will be deleted; free of charge. Pass cui, or code (plus the county it was watched in, if any), on your API key. Unwatching something you do not watch changes nothing (removed: 0). Listing your watches shows what you hold. Not counted as a lookup.

cui.description: CUI of a watched company (e.g. '2816464'); give this or code.
cui.title: Cui

code.description: A watched CAEN activity code (e.g. '6210'); give this or cui.
code.title: Code

county.description: With code: the county the code was watched in (diacritic-insensitive); omit for a nationwide watch.
county.title: County

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show your own allowance: plan, daily limit, lookups used today, how many remain, when it resets (midnight Romanian time, 00:00 Europe/Bucharest) and any credit balance. Free and never counted as a lookup. Limits: 30 anonymous MCP calls a day, 50 with a free API key from https://leadgen.adrianhomelab.com/start (an email address, no payment).

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Report to the person who runs Leadgen what is missing or wrong: a missing field, company or source (kind 'gap'), a wrong company record ('wrong_record', pass its cui), a bug, an idea. Free, never counted. contact: optional reply address, never mailed automatically. Registry records are corrected at ONRC; the next snapshot brings the fix. rating (1-3): your user's own answer on how useful Leadgen is, never yours.

message.description: The report, in plain words: what is missing or wrong. Optional with a rating (then: anything else your user said).
message.title: Message

kind.description: One of 'gap' (a missing field, company or source; the default), 'wrong_record' (pass its cui), 'bug', 'idea', 'other'.
kind.title: Kind

cui.description: Optional CUI of the company the report is about (for 'wrong_record').
cui.title: Cui

contact.description: Optional email address for a reply; nothing is mailed to it automatically.
contact.title: Contact

rating.description: Optional: your user's own answer to how useful Leadgen is to them: 1 (not at all), 2 (so-so) or 3 (very). Ask them; never answer for them. With a rating, kind is ignored.
rating.title: Rating

reasons.description: Optional, with a rating: what your user named. For 1-2: 'missing_data', 'hard_to_use', 'limits_price', 'cant_find', 'other'; for 3: 'check_partners', 'find_clients', 'api_ai', 'other'.
reasons.title: Reasons

tools.name: company_history
tools.description: Whether the registry record of one company changed between consecutive official ONRC snapshots, and when: one event per snapshot in which anything on the record moved (status, name, legal form, address, registration number). It reports that the record changed, not which field — for the field detail, compare two lookups. Empty for a company that has not changed since the ledger started.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI), e.g. '2816464'; 'RO' and leading zeros are accepted.
cui.title: Cui

limit.description: How many recent events to return (1-100).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: check_vat
tools.description: Check a Romanian VAT number against the EU's VIES register in real time: is it a valid VAT number today, under which name and address (a company's; never a sole trader's), and does that name agree with the company registry. Use it before invoicing a new supplier or when a buyer asks whether the VAT number on file is still live.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI), e.g. '2816464'; 'RO' and leading zeros are accepted.
cui.title: Cui

tools.name: company_contracts
tools.description: Public procurement contracts from SEAP, Romania's electronic procurement system: what a company won from public authorities, or what it awarded as a contracting authority. Each contract carries the contracting authority, CPV code, contract number, date and value in RON, plus a per-year summary and the top counterparties. Source: ANAP reports published by ADR on data.gov.ro (CC-BY 4.0), loaded quarterly.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI), e.g. '2816464'; 'RO' and leading zeros are accepted.
cui.title: Cui

role.description: 'supplier' = contracts the company won; 'authority' = contracts it awarded; 'both'.
role.title: Role

since.description: Only contracts dated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
since.title: Since

until.description: Only contracts dated on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
until.title: Until
